venues.name: Truck 59 Ciderhouse
venues.source: Email from Dana Haudenschild (Director of Marketing, Jason Parkes Customs) for Truck 59, 2026-10-14

expect.description: Truck 59 Ciderhouse is an orchard cidery in West Kelowna with a smart layout: a main lawn where families and dogs are welcome, and a separate adults-only lounge, so it suits almost any kind of visit. Either way, lawn games are on hand.

set.description: In the heart of Okanagan Wine Country, Truck 59 is where crisp cider, wide-open lawns, and lakeside lounging come together. Now serving Hatching Post beer, cocktails, and JPC wine in our Truck Yard!
set.description_fr: Au cœur du pays viticole de l'Okanagan, Truck 59 réunit cidre frais, grandes pelouses et détente au bord du lac. On y sert maintenant la bière Hatching Post, des cocktails et le vin JPC dans notre Truck Yard !

venues.name: Bean to Cup
venues.source: Email from Kunal at Bean to Cup, 2026-10-14 (confirmed the listing, sent photos)

expect.description: Bean to Cup is the Vernon cafe locals default to: strong coffee, homemade food and an unpretentious warmth. Dogs are always welcome on the front terrace, so bring yours and grab a seat outside for the morning.

set.description: Bean to Cup is the Vernon cafe locals default to: strong coffee, homemade food and an unpretentious warmth. Butter chicken is on the menu every Wednesday. Dogs are always welcome on the front terrace, so bring yours and grab a seat outside for the morning.
set.description_fr: Bean to Cup est le café où les gens de Vernon vont d'office : du café corsé, une cuisine maison et une chaleur sans prétention. Le poulet au beurre est au menu tous les mercredis. Les chiens sont toujours les bienvenus sur la terrasse à l'avant : amenez le vôtre et prenez une place dehors pour la matinée.
